releases.name: CTRL+Z 1.1.3 - unified logo
releases.body:
## CTRL+Z 1.1.3 - unified logo

The exact in-app mark (ember rounded square, white Z, right-offset dash) is now the single logo source across the app.

### Changed

- Window/taskbar icon.
- Executable icon and installer icon.
- Sidebar/header brand mark now uses the rendered PNG asset.
- Settings > About mark now uses the same asset.
- `branding/` contains the exact high-resolution logo, transparent mark, and ICO.

No functional behavior changed. Existing profiles, backups, install state, and browser data are untouched.

releases.name: CTRL+Z 1.1.2 - Select all by filter
releases.body:
## CTRL+Z 1.1.2 - Select all on the Scan page

### New

- **Select all** button in the Scan footer.
- It selects every app visible under the active filter:
  - **All apps** ? all scanned apps.
  - **Matched** ? every matched app.
  - **Unmatched** ? every unmatched app.
- **Select matched** remains as the matched-only shortcut and also respects the current search/category filters.
- Selection count in the footer updates immediately.

### Verified

- All apps: 163 selected.
- Matched: 105 selected.
- Unmatched: 58 selected.

releases.name: CTRL+Z 1.1.0 - Firefox and Zen support
releases.body:
## CTRL+Z 1.1.0 - Firefox and Zen support

**Undo a clean Windows install.** This release adds full Firefox-family backup and restore while keeping the Chromium flow intact.

### New in 1.1.0

- **Firefox-family detection** for Mozilla Firefox/ESR, **Zen**, LibreWolf, Waterfox, Floorp, Mullvad Browser, and Tor Browser.
- **Firefox profile reading** via `profiles.ini`, including single-profile Tor/Mullvad-style bundles.
- **Firefox backups** of `prefs.js`/`user.js`, `places.sqlite` (bookmarks/history), `sessionstore.jsonlz4` and session backups, extensions and extension storage, search engines, site permissions, bookmark backups, and `chrome/` customizations.
- **Restore as new profiles** for Firefox registers new profiles in `profiles.ini`; Chromium still registers them in `Local State`.
- **Same-engine safety:** archives are tagged as Chromium or Firefox and cannot be restored into the other engine.
- **Credential exclusions:** Firefox `logins.json`, `key4.db`, `cookies.sqlite`, `formhistory.sqlite`, and related stores are never archived; Chromium cookies/Login Data/os_crypt remain excluded.
- Running-browser detection now covers Firefox-family process names as well as Chromium.
- UI now shows Chromium/Firefox family badges, filters restore targets by engine, and includes an updated Firefox/Zen restore screenshot.

### Fixes included

- Archive inspection now shows the profile list immediately instead of waiting for a redraw.
- Archive metadata now labels the browser engine.
- Version metadata and footer now report 1.1.0.
- Firefox restored profile names are made unique (`Work (restored)`).
- UTF-8 BOM in `profiles.ini`/`Local State` is handled safely.

### Assets

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `CTRL+Z-Portable-1.1.0.exe` | Self-contained single-file portable app. |
| `CTRL+Z-Setup-1.1.0.exe` | Per-user installer with shortcuts and uninstaller. |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 checksums. |
| `BUILD-INFO.txt` | Build/platform notes. |

### Notes

- Windows 10 1809+ / Windows 11, x64.
- Binaries are **unsigned**, so SmartScreen may warn.
- Browser passwords/cookies are not backed up by design. See the README and `docs/TESTING-RESTORE.md`.
- Source: https://github.com/IAM-GROOT1/ctrlz

releases.name: CTRL+Z 1.0.0
releases.body:
## CTRL+Z 1.0.0

**Undo a clean Windows install.**

CTRL+Z is a local-first Windows desktop app that rebuilds your app list and restores Chromium browser profiles after a fresh install.

### Included

- Scan via winget, Windows registry Uninstall keys, and Microsoft Store apps.
- Portable JSON profiles with multiple saved PC setups.
- Direct URL, GitHub latest-release, and local/USB installer sources with silent-switch detection and testing.
- Live Chris Titus WinUtil catalog with cached/embedded offline fallbacks.
- Silent install queue with progress, per-app status, logs, retry, pause, reboot handling, resume, winget bootstrap, and UAC relaunch.
- Chromium browser backup/restore for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera/Opera GX, Helium, Chromium, and other forks.
- Browser backups include tabs/sessions, bookmarks, history, extensions, preferences, flags, search engines, and site permissions.
- Saved passwords and cookies are deliberately excluded. Caches and crash data are excluded. Optional AES-256 ZIP encryption.
- Dark/light Fluent-style UI with real app icons.

### Assets

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `CTRL+Z-Portable-1.0.0.exe` | Self-contained single-file portable app. |
| `CTRL+Z-Setup-1.0.0.exe` | Per-user installer with Start Menu shortcut and uninstaller. |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 checksums. |
| `BUILD-INFO.txt` | Build and platform notes. |

### Notes

- Windows 10 1809+ / Windows 11, x64.
- Binaries are **unsigned**, so SmartScreen may warn.
- Browser passwords/cookies are not backed up. See the README and `docs/TESTING-RESTORE.md` for known limitations and a fresh-VM test procedure.
- Source, architecture, build instructions, and screenshots: https://github.com/IAM-GROOT1/ctrlz
